channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Stephon Marbury | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Stephon Marbury from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Steve Nash, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:SGA on Stephon Marbury calling him the best all-time player from Canada:

“I appreciate it but Steve (Nash) is still ahead of me. Imma try to catch him but he's still ahead of me.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Steve Nash, Stephon Marbury, Feb 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Tony Parker, Jason Kidd, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
Jackson said via Showtime.

“Speedy Claxton saved us. I don't know why they don't talk about Speedy Claxton and give him his props bro. Tony Parker was near the bench every fourth quarter because Steph [Stephon Marbury] was frying him. Jason Kidd was frying him.”

Stephen Jackson on Tony Parker, Jason Kidd, Stephon Marbury, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Spike Lee on Stephon Marbury
item.description:
In a 1998 interview with The New York Times, Spike Lee, born in Atlanta and raised in Brooklyn, addressed the eerie similarities between Marbury and Shuttlesworth.

“Even though Stephon, and his father, and his brothers, might think this is the Marbury story, it’s not about them,”

Spike Lee on Stephon Marbury, May 2, 2019. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Rajon Rondo on if he's going to mentor Lonzo Ball:

“Yeah that's obviously. My rookie year my guys were Sam Cassell, Stephon Marbury, and Eddie House. I didn't look at this guys as competition.”

Rajon Rondo on Eddie House, Stephon Marbury, Sam Cassell, Lonzo Ball, Sep 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @bgarciaivsports.

item.title: Al Harrington on Stephon Marbury
item.description:
“Stephon has it all over there so I knew if anyone could get it done it would be him – I'm just mad I didn't think of it sooner,”

Al Harrington on Stephon Marbury, Oct 31, 2015. Source: Sydney Morning Herald.

item.title: Larry Brown on Isiah Thomas, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
“Marbury was not our problem. That’s not fair. Isiah (Thomas) and Marbury were a problem because Marbury and Isiah were connected at the hip, and there was no chance for Stephon to be able to play for me. But he was a good kid and had really no chance (of) being successful the way the dynamics worked out. A coach needs to be able to coach a team and needs the president, the owner, the GM – everybody – to be on the same page. Jim Dolan gave me every chance to be successful, but we didn’t have any unity in the way that program was run. And as a result, it struggled. “If you look at the great NBA franchises,”

Larry Brown on Isiah Thomas, Stephon Marbury, Mar 3, 2015. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Lance Stephenson on Stephon Marbury
item.description:
Last October, Stephenson told us that the Marbury was one of the AND1 shoes he wanted to see retroed.

“I want the Sprewells to come back out. I want the Stephon Marburys to come back out,”

Lance Stephenson on Stephon Marbury, Feb 10, 2015. Source: Sole Collector.
